At 100 units BASE the variable cost excluding the COST-16 tooling/NRE amortisation line and the COST-12 installation service line (EUR per unit) is: HUB 281.13, WATCH 190.90, SENSE 88.27, DISPLAY 303.32, AIS 281.35, PILOT 0.00 known (no cost exists).

The COST-16 line is 27.5% of the HUB 100-unit known subtotal, 24.6% for WATCH, 20.8% for SENSE, 19.9% for DISPLAY and 13.5% for AIS: it is a one-off cost divided by volume, not a property of the product.

Observed public-price coverage (COST-01 share of the 100-unit BASE known subtotal) is HUB 1.8%, WATCH 2.0%, SENSE 4.7%, DISPLAY 0.8%, AIS 2.1%; every other material category is an ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION. Coverage therefore spans 0.8-4.7% of the modelled subtotal.

CONDITIONAL (not a margin or profitability statement): under the MC-12 governance VAT convention (Spain 21% illustration, net = gross / 1.21, disclosed per revenue line) and the unapproved VAT-inclusive retail hypotheses, at 100 units BASE the known variable cost excluding COST-16 and COST-12 exceeds the ex-VAT price hypothesis for AIS (281.35 vs 205.79) and SENSE (88.27 vs 81.82); it is below the hypothesis for HUB (281.13 vs 288.43), WATCH (190.90 vs 247.11) and DISPLAY (303.32 vs 577.69).

CONDITIONAL, same assumptions: AIS is above its ex-VAT price hypothesis at every modelled BASE volume (1/10/100/500/1000); SENSE is above it at 1, 10 and 100 units and falls below it at 500 and 1000 units. PILOT cannot be compared because no PILOT cost amount exists.

COST-12 installation is a separate service line of HUB 36.00, WATCH 54.00, SENSE 45.00, DISPLAY 60.00 and AIS 39.00 EUR per unit at 100 units BASE; it is excluded from the variable-cost comparison above, is included only when the configuration includes installation, and no installer rate or channel price exists.
